heroHeadline: China Claims Philippine Military Aircraft Intruded Into South China Sea Airspace Near Pag-asa
heroSubtitle: Beijing alleges a Philippine military aircraft violated airspace over disputed South China Sea waters near Pag-asa Island, escalating aerial tensions following a string of coast guard confrontations and flare incidents targeting Philippine patrol aircraft in the Spratlys.
